Summary notes from calls and POC.

- Primary ask: ensure agent-assist and ticket summarization stay within 200ms median, 800ms p99 under sustained spikes (holiday windows).
- Key quote from CTO: "We cannot have degraded agents during Black Friday windows — need graceful degradation and predictable cost."
- Interested in Redwood's Dedicated pools + autoscaling with burst capacity. Wants clear pricing for burst minutes.
- Security team insists on KMS integration & retention policy controls; legal flagged data residency for EU customers.
- Integration note: Genesys Cloud is core telephony + routing; wants Redwood to act as model service behind existing callflows and tool-calls (CRM update automation).
- POC feedback: prefix/KV caching helped reduce token costs for repeated prompts, but tail latency spikes when concurrent cold sessions hit new model variants.

requirements_summary: Workload: agent-assist (real-time, sub-1s target) + async ticket summarization for backlog. Throughput: spiky bursts up to 2.5k reqs/sec during promo periods; normal steady 200-300 reqs/sec. Must support model routing by region and auto-fallback to smaller/quantized models. Observability: per-request trace, token-level cost, and alerting on quality regressions.
technical_notes: Prefer GPUs with fast KV cache (A100 or H100 equivalent)
Need support for quantized 4-bit variants for cost containment during bursts
Must expose function/tool calling hooks for CRM writes (Salesforce/Genesys), with idempotency guarantees
Require prefix/KV cache warmup strategy for agent sessions to avoid cold-start latency
spike_profile: Predictable seasonal peaks (Nov-Dec retail), recurring weekly spikes M-F 9am-11am PST, and incident bursts when upstream telephony degrades (failover events). Target burst window sizing: 48 hrs at x2 baseline, micro-bursts to x10 for <10 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Fallback to quantized model results in <=5% drop in agent satisfaction score (customer-provided prompts)
Cost for burst period capped to pre-agreed committed rate or transparent overage pricing
Security: KMS integration verified in staging, SSO flows validated
